body:
**Handoff from MMR-66 (settlement display copies).** On a periodic world every settlement gets one display copy at its strip image (`World/PeriodicMapPresentation.cs`, `docs/periodic-presentation.md`). What MMR-40 must keep true:

- **Build time.** The copy is `GameEntity.CopyFrom(scene, settlementEntity, true, false)` of the visual's `StrategicEntity`. It is built once, in a postfix of `SettlementVisual.OnStartup`.
  - Gates, port and blockade children placed under the settlement's entity *before* `OnStartup` are copied.
  - Children added later get no mirror. `Sync` pairs originals and mirrors by hierarchy index, truncated to the shorter list.
  - If MMR-40 adds entities after startup, it must rebuild the copy: remove the record (as `OnPartyRemoved` does) and call `BuildCopy` again.
- **Identity.**
  - The copy is named `<settlementId>_display_<east|west>`. Every copy entity is registered in `MapScreen.VisualsOfEntities` to the settlement's own visual, so picks resolve to the canonical settlement.
  - The copy has no tags, so tag scans (`port`, drop-offs, siege spawns) find only the settlement's entities. Keep gameplay lookups tag- or settlement-based, never by entity name prefix.
- **Visibility.** The copy mirrors the settlement entities' visibility after `SetSettlementLevelVisibility`, `RefreshWallState`, `RefreshSiegePreparations` and `ValidateIsDirty`. Level and wall meshes must stay children of the settlement entity for this to hold.
- **Positions.**
  - Settlement entities must sit at canonical x in [W/2, 3W/2). The strips are W/2 wide, so there is exactly one strip image.
  - A port whose position lies across the cut from its town is averaged beside the town for the camera by construction. Not fixture-tested.
- **Fixture copies.** `tools/scenebin/build_periodic_world.py` emits static copies named `<worldId>_display_<id without prefix>_<side>`. The runtime removes them when it builds its own. In-process placement should stop emitting static copies.
- **Evidence.** Run 33944: 4 copies (19 entities per town, 6 per village), picked through `SelectEntitiesCollidedWith` + `OnVisualIntersected` to the canonical town, with 0 visibility differences.
